attributes.provenance: src/game/world/gauntworld.c::fn_800606FC (worktree GDL-Claude-Gauntworld, commit e8da20c55): sItemRuntime accessed at 4 sites spread across the entire ~2221-insn function (offsets +3256, +idx*40, +30184/+30188/+30192) all resolved via ONE `lis+addi` at function+0x1c into r23, verified byte-exact against target's 4 immediate-displacement uses off that single register. Fixed by adding `u8* rt = sItemRuntime;` as the FIRST local declared/initialized (before any conditional), replacing all 4 raw `sItemRuntime + off` expressions with `rt + off`. real diff dropped 1468->1384 lines, fuzzy 95.76%->96.77%.
attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family with the per-TU flags in configure.py; applies to large (1000+ insn) functions where a fixed global/array address is read at several non-adjacent, non-dominating call sites

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: When a fixed global array/struct address is dereferenced at several scattered points across a large function (sites that do not dominate each other, e.g. in different loop iterations or switch cases), writing the raw `GLOBAL + off` expression fresh at each site does NOT reproduce target if target hoisted the base address once. The tell: target's disassembly shows exactly ONE `lis+addi` for the symbol, in a callee-saved GPR, used at every site via plain immediate-displacement loads (`lfs off(rN)` / `add rD,rN,rIdx`), even though the first use may be hundreds of instructions later. Fix: declare `T* p = GLOBAL;` as the very first local (before any conditional/branch), so its initializer executes unconditionally at function entry, forcing MWCC to compute the address once and keep it live in a saved register for the whole function; replace all `GLOBAL + off` occurrences with `p + off`. Verify via fnasm.py that the target GPR appears in exactly one lis+addi pair and N immediate-displacement uses before applying — this law does NOT apply when target itself recomputes the address per site (see the companion residual in fn_8005C1DC/fn_8005F0F4 where a similarly-repeated stack address was rematerialized fresh by target at every call site instead of cached; caching there made real strictly worse). This is a companion/inverse to the member-form-kills-addr-pre and stride-array-table-view laws: those kill a spurious cached derived-pointer web by naming distinct struct fields off one base; this law CREATES a needed whole-function cache when target genuinely keeps one address resident for many uses.
